info.title: sloc
info.description: A .NET global CLI tool that counts code, comment, and blank lines across source files. Supports 23 languages with auto-detection, three output formats (table, JSON, HTML), per-file detail view, and comment health indicators.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Sloc - counts code, comment, and blank lines in source files.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information.

options.name: --include
options.description: Glob pattern of files to include. Can be specified multiple times.

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Glob pattern of files to exclude. Can be specified multiple times.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: Table, Json, or Html. Inferred from the --output extension when omitted.

options.name: --no-recursive
options.description: Do not descend into subdirectories. [default: False]

options.name: --by-file
options.description: Show a per-file breakdown in addition to the language summary. [default: False]

options.name: --paged
options.description: Enable pagination when displaying the per-file breakdown. [default: False]

options.name: --all
options.description: Include files whose extension maps to no known language. [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path for Json and Html formats. Use '-' to write to stdout.

options.name: --no-health
options.description: Hide the Comment Health column and percentage breakdowns. [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the banner, progress UI, and 'Saved to' message. [default: False]

options.name: --no-progress
options.description: Suppress the live table and progress bar. [default: False]

options.name: --min-comment-pct
options.description: Fail (exit code 2) if the overall comment percentage is below this value.

options.name: --jobs
options.description: Maximum number of files to analyze in parallel. Defaults to the processor count; use 1 for sequential.

options.name: --no-gitignore
options.description: Do not honor .gitignore files (they are respected by default). [default: False]

options.name: --baseline
options.description: Compare against a previously saved JSON report and show the line-count diff.

options.name: --sort
options.description: Order the language summary by: Total (default), Code, Comment, Blank, Files, or Name.

options.name: --top
options.description: Show only the top N languages in the summary.

options.name: --no-update-check
options.description: Do not check GitHub for a newer release (checked by default, with a 2 second timeout). [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The file or directory to analyze. [default: .]
